season.evidence: Search of club and guidebook-derived route pages: early season needs axes, snow-free hiking via the Pinnacle trail later; Mountaineers/Mazamas outings run early June to September. Stored Jul-Sep kept; Peakbagger summits peak Jul-Sep (193/140/160).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged route 'Summer route to East Ridge', 13 Jun 2026, summited, complete round trip from the Reflection Lakes pin (start 13 m, summit 25 m), in season (Jun is within a month of Jul). But there is no trip report; the line goes up the saddle trail, around the south side behind the peak and onto the summit from the east, and never reaches the Castle-Pinnacle col where our 5.5 three-pitch East Ridge starts. Looks like the walk-up scramble, not the roped ridge, so identity is not proven.
31 May, trail/scramble line with a rope used only on a summit-block downclimb; not the East Ridge and outside the window by more than a month.
Off-trail scramble from Reflection Lakes, class 2-3 summit scramble, not the east ridge.
Logged as South ridge; scramble line.
Logged Reflection Lakes; party led a short crack at the summit block after crossing behind the peak; not the east ridge pitches.

notes: Only East Ridge (5.5, roped, from the Castle-Pinnacle col) needed a track; no Peakbagger recording clearly climbs it (every summited track follows the south-side scramble). The Pinnacle Saddle / South Gully route already holds a track. East Ridge trailhead pin (Reflection Lakes) agrees with all track starts to within 40 m.
